core_engines.functionality: Fetches The Odds API data, normalizes games and bookmaker prices, validates freshness and format, and exposes failover/circuit-breaker behavior. The repository also has free ESPN odds, nflverse, MLB Stats API, ClubElo, Kalshi and other adapters in the ingestion package.

mathematical_models.value: American odds → implied probability: positive odds p=100/(odds+100); negative odds p=|odds|/(|odds|+100).
Two-way proportional de-vig: p_i^fair = p_i^implied / Σp_implied.

core_engines.functionality: Scores SPREAD, TOTAL and MONEYLINE candidates from bookmaker consensus, market depth, de-vigged fair probability, edge, dispersion/volatility and game-context factors. It refuses thin/low-consensus markets, assigns confidence 0–100, grade, risk and FREE/PREMIUM tier, and emits a factor breakdown and reasoning.

mathematical_models.value: Confidence is a clamped sum of consensus, depth, edge, volatility penalty, context signals and a +10 base; MIN_PUBLISH_CONFIDENCE=50 and PREMIUM_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD=70.
Pricing edge = fair probability − offered probability; edge is mapped so 0% is half-score and +5 percentage points is full edge-component score.
The scorer requires at least 2 bookmakers and MONEYLINE requires fair probability ≥0.58.

core_engines.functionality: Separates a genuine independent estimate from the sportsbook echo. It blends non-sportsbook estimators, compares them with market fair probability, applies evidence/uncertainty/agreement shrinkage, and returns SPEAK/LEAN/PASS plus expected CLV. Ranking uses an independent true probability when available—even on PASS—while the public edge claim remains separately gated.

mathematical_models.value: Weighted true probability = Σ(weight_i·prob_i)/Σweight_i; raw edge = trueProb − marketFairProb.
Agreement multipliers: CONFIRMS ×1.0, SOLO ×0.6, SPLIT ×0.5, CONTRADICTS ×0; SPEAK requires shrunk edge ≥0.025 and LEAN ≥0.012.
Ranking blend defaults to 0.7 independent trueProb + 0.3 confidence probability; raw edge/edgeScore are explicitly forbidden as ranking p.

core_engines.functionality: Exports non-seed settled picks, applies close-price Shin de-vig, measures CLV, performs a time-ordered holdout, fits centered isotonic calibration, reports ECE/Brier/reliability, and only then reaches fractional/portfolio Kelly. Live calibration remains behind CALIBRATION_ADJUSTMENTS_ENABLED and a human MODEL_VERSION gate.

mathematical_models.value: PAVA isotonic regression pools adjacent forecast blocks that violate monotonicity; CenteredIsotonic (CIR) collapses PAVA plateaus to mass-weighted centers and interpolates to preserve ranking resolution.
Brier = mean((p−y)^2); Murphy diagnostics expose reliability, resolution and uncertainty=baseRate·(1−baseRate).
ECE is the sample-weighted mean absolute gap between bin mean forecast and observed outcome rate.

The documented sizing path uses fractional/portfolio Kelly, κ≈0.25–0.30, caps, James–Stein edge shrink, correlation haircut and a CLV deflator; CLV deflates stakes to zero until roughly 50 settled CLV samples.

core_engines.functionality: Loads public nflverse play-by-play, fits completion/rush/YAC expectation models on the season, aggregates residuals into GSE-CPOE, GSE-RYOE and GSE-xYAC, and validates/compares against Next Gen Stats. A separate EPA layer adjusts team offense and defense for opponent strength.

mathematical_models.value: Opponent-adjusted EPA solves epa ≈ leagueMean + offense[posteam] + defense[defteam] with iterative Gauss–Seidel/coordinate descent and zero-mean re-centering.
GSE expected metrics are play-level residual rollups for CPOE, RYOE and xYAC, rather than projections or picks.

core_engines.functionality: Provides seven reference de-vig methods and a same-match parlay MRI. Fair probabilities are calibration inputs rather than an automatic scoring override; same-game leg survivability is computed on a correlated score grid.

mathematical_models.value: Methods: multiplicative, additive, power, Shin, differential-margin-weighting, odds-ratio and logarithmic; root finding uses bisection.
Same-match parlay correlation uses Karlis–Ntzoufras bivariate Poisson: joint score cells use λ1, λ2, λ3 and are compared with a naive product-of-marginals grid.

core_engines.functionality: Jarvis synthesizes structured database counts into launch status, sectional health, warnings and next actions. Canonical-history, sample-size, publication, settlement, source and signal gates control what crosses from internal to public; missing data becomes UNKNOWN rather than a fabricated number.

mathematical_models.value: Public performance is blocked when the readiness gate is false, canonical settled picks are below the default 25, or the recent window is entirely bootstrap.

api_integrations.value: The Odds API: primary licensed odds feed; The Odds API key is required for live odds ingestion.
ESPN public odds and scoreboard endpoints: free tertiary odds path when licensed sources are empty, rate-limited or unavailable.
nflverse release assets: CC-BY-4.0 play-by-play, EPA/WPA, air yards, Next Gen Stats, snap/depth-chart and player-stat data.
MLB Stats API, ClubElo, ESPN results/power index, Kalshi, NoVig/Rundown and Open-Meteo appear as source adapters or independent evidence paths in the ingestion tree and model-version notes.
Google OAuth/NextAuth for sign-in; Stripe checkout/webhooks for subscriptions; PostgreSQL/Prisma for persistence; Redis/BullMQ for background workers; Anthropic Claude API for content drafts.

backend_architecture.workflows_and_routing: The intended path is: scheduled data-refresh retrieves odds and free/statistical sources → normalizers enforce schema, American-odds format and freshness → ingestion-pipeline writes games/odds and evidence → prediction-engine scores market candidates and independently derived probabilities → selective/readiness gates decide whether a pick is internally eligible → pick-generation persists versioned picks and audit factors → settlement grades WIN/LOSS/PUSH and captures close/CLV → calibration jobs build held-out reports and shadow-vs-live comparisons → the operator cockpit exposes diagnostics. Public routes read only canonical, settled, published data and return honest bootstrap/empty states when gates are closed. The content worker is draft-only by default; API v1 durable persistence is explicitly shadow/proposal-only, with a boundary guard blocking live routes, Prisma models, migrations and provider calls until owner approval.

theoretical_frameworks.value: Market microstructure as benchmark rather than oracle: the edge engine treats sportsbook de-vigged fair price as a reference and independent estimators as the opinion.
Calibration theory: PAVA/CIR isotonic regression, Platt/Beta calibration research references, Murphy Brier decomposition, reliability curves and ECE.
Opponent adjustment follows an SRS-style additive model estimated by Gauss–Seidel coordinate descent.
The repository explicitly references Skellam cover modeling for spread ranking and Dixon–Coles for soccer independent estimation in its model-version history.

Related mathematical foundations: statsmodels supplies GLM, Poisson/negative-binomial/count models, ARIMA/VAR/VECM, state-space and Markov-switching methods; the distribution tutorial covers Bernoulli/binomial, Beta/Dirichlet, Gaussian and Student-t probability theory.

repository_analysis.optimization_opportunities: 1) Make the independent model layer the primary decision object and keep market-echo confidence as a separate UX score; require two independent estimators for publishable edge wherever possible. 2) Materialize immutable point-in-time feature snapshots and closing prices so no future information leaks into training or CLV. 3) Replace repeated broad scans with batched ingestion, indexes and durable feature/calibration artifacts; the current design already recognizes that large PBP work belongs in offline/precompute rather than the hot path. 4) Add sport/market-stratified walk-forward backtests, uncertainty intervals and benchmark-vs-close reporting before changing MODEL_VERSION. 5) Treat ESPN/free sources as explicit quality tiers with provenance and disagreement policy, never as silent substitutes. 6) Keep the fail-closed circuit breaker, source rights registry and API-v1 boundary; promote only after synthetic replay, disposable-DB rehearsal, rollback and owner approval. 7) For LLM narratives, add structured JSON output, claim-to-source IDs, deterministic numeric checks, prompt-injection tests and human review; never let generated prose alter picks or gates.

Research-agent pattern: MiroThinker routes search through Serper, scraping through Jina, code execution through E2B, summarization through a selectable LLM and evaluation through repeated benchmark runs with traces.
Evaluation-first pattern: UpTrain recommends fixed datasets and evaluators for context relevance, factual accuracy, completeness, consistency, prompt injection, jailbreaks and prompt/model drift.

Workflow generation and creative multimodality: the supplied AI repositories catalog RAG, MCP, memory, multimodal, voice, OCR and fine-tuning patterns, while Google documents Gemini/Vertex AI use in media, sports and physical-world workflows.

enterprise_workflows.value: Recommended Sports workflow: source registry/rights → point-in-time ingestion → deterministic feature/model computation → evidence envelope → calibrated probability/edge gate → human/operator review → draft narrative → claim/evaluation gate → controlled publication. This mirrors Google’s agentic orchestration pattern while preserving Sports’ hard gates.

RAG workflow: document/PBP/scouting ingestion → parse/chunk → metadata filter by sport/team/date/rights → hybrid retrieval/rerank → answer with citations; AWS GenU explicitly exposes parsing, chunk selection, decomposition, reranking and metadata filters.

Sandbox workflow: untrusted/generated code is executed in an isolated, stateful Sandbox with persistent/hibernated state and no production credentials; Kubernetes Agent Sandbox identifies AI-agent runtimes and RL/evaluation as target use cases.

Model operations workflow: keep every training run self-contained with model, scaler, running averages and error manifest; BlairCurrey’s NFL project loads only the latest complete run and evaluates against naive/Vegas baselines.

Statistical decision workflow: use count/time-series/state-space/VAR models from statsmodels where assumptions fit, then calibrate and compare to simpler baselines and closing market; do not treat model complexity as evidence of edge.

Reliability workflow: apply fail-closed provider circuits, multi-host/free-source failover, freshness validation, rights/provenance labels and explicit stale/unknown states. Sports’ Odds API circuit opens on decisive 402 and allows one half-open probe after a six-hour window without inventing quotes.

Enterprise deployment pattern: AWS GenU uses CDK to provision the application and exposes deployment options, cost estimation, security settings, SAML and model-region configuration; this is a useful template for environment separation and repeatable infrastructure.

Responsible AI/observability workflow: evaluate generated outputs for factual grounding, completeness, safety and drift; UpTrain’s rationale is that evaluation prevents regressions and helps build transparency/trust, while Sports’ Jarvis blocks launch claims when safety warnings are active.
Edge-performance workflow: nn-Meter predicts fused-kernel latency and can filter NAS candidates by a device latency threshold; use this for any future real-time video/voice or mobile Sports surface.
